description: This header file defines the abstract class `em_discovery_t`, which encapsulates methods for creating, analyzing, and processing topology discovery, query, and response messages within a network discovery protocol. It also specifies virtual functions for retrieving MAC addresses, sending frames, and managing commands and state related to network topology discovery in a mesh network environment.

classes.name: em_discovery_t
classes.description: An abstract class providing interfaces for topology discovery message creation, analysis, state management, and network communication in a mesh networking context.

methods.name: create_topo_discovery_msg
methods.description: Creates a topology discovery message and stores it in the provided buffer.

methods.name: create_topo_query_msg
methods.description: Creates a topology query message and stores it in the provided buffer.

methods.name: create_topo_rsp_msg
methods.description: Creates a topology response message and stores it in the provided buffer.

methods.name: analyze_topo_disc_msg
methods.description: Analyzes a topology discovery message buffer.

methods.name: analyze_topo_query_msg
methods.description: Analyzes a topology query message buffer.

methods.name: analyze_topo_resp_msg
methods.description: Analyzes a topology response message buffer.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Returns the current state of the discovery process as an `em_state_t` value.

methods.name: get_radio_interface_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the radio interface; must be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: get_al_interface_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the AL interface; must be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: send_frame
methods.description: Sends a data frame over the network; must be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: get_current_cmd
methods.description: Returns the current command being processed; must be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: get_mgr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the manager instance associated with this discovery object; must be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: process_msg
methods.description: Processes a message given its data and length.

methods.name: process_state
methods.description: Handles the current state of the discovery process.
